title: Iterated extension relation
statement: For bit strings $w,z$ and a nonnegative integer $k$, define $z$ to extend $w$ in $k$ steps recursively: at zero steps this means $z=w$; at $k+1$ steps it means there is a bit string $v$ such that $z$ extends the self-delimiting pairing of $w$ and $v$ in $k$ steps.
